data.value: Aibell is an independent project, written from scratch. It owes a debt to two earlier players.

data.name: About.Credits.Songbird
data.value: The open-source media player. Much of Aibell's interface (the browsing panes, the source list, the dense track table) follows Songbird's design, which in turn drew on iTunes. Aibell copies no Songbird code or artwork; the resemblance is a deliberate homage.

data.name: About.Credits.Banshee
data.value: The Mono/GTK media player, whose practical library view and local-first approach inspired Aibell. Aibell contains no Banshee source code.

data.name: About.Credits.Thanks
data.value: Thank you to the people behind both projects. Aibell is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. Songbird and iTunes are trademarks of their respective owners.

data.name: About.Credits.Libraries
